chapter.en: Chapter I · The light is still on

premise.zh: 文明纪元在核火及其引发的长潮中终结。地下放映站、盐环聚落与理想城各有灯火；孢子、变异生灵、变种人与觉醒者共同生活。这里收拢旧影像，也给尚未走完的路留着空白。
premise.en: Nuclear fire and the Long Tide it triggers end the Civilization Era. Underground stations, Salt Ring settlements and Ideal City keep their own lights; spores, altered life, mutants and Awakened people share the world. Here, old images are gathered and unfinished routes retain their blank spaces.

kind.zh: 地下避难所 · 有人守候
kind.en: Underground shelter · A light kept on

description.zh: 旧铁路线终点的防辐射地下避难所，也是还在运转的最后一间放映室。文明纪元幸存的影像在这里归档，无论是拾荒者、变种人行商还是觉醒者旅人，都能借一晚灯光。
description.en: A radiation-shielded underground shelter at the end of an old railway, and its last working screening room. Surviving images from the Civilization Era are catalogued here; scavengers, mutant traders, and Awakened travelers alike may borrow its light.

kind.zh: 幸存者聚落 · 路标已立

description.zh: 盐壳包住文明纪元停运的列车车厢，地表幸存者与温顺的变种人匠人在此筑起聚落。弥途把能走的路画在车门内侧，行商与驮兽总会顺着路标回来补上一笔。
description.en: Salt crusts the train carriages left from the Civilization Era, where surface survivors and gentle mutant artisans built a settlement. Mitu marks passable routes inside the doors; traders and pack beasts always return to redraw the lines.

kind.zh: 孢子共生 · 等待打捞

description.zh: 核爆后沉入回声海的文明纪元资料库，退潮时露出圆形屋顶。馆内冷光闪烁的自进化孢子包裹着密封胶片盒，替旧世界守住了未受潮水侵蚀的底片。
description.en: A Civilization Era repository submerged after the nuclear fall, its circular roof exposed at low tide. Bioluminescent self-evolving spores wrap the sealed film cans inside, shielding old reels from the water.

kind.zh: 变异生态 · 传闻地带

description.zh: 核爆与长潮漫过旧城形成的辐射内海，岸边栖息着循电磁波迁徙的温和变异水鸟。迟灯与路过的觉醒者都听见过，海浪里偶尔会多出一个旧纪元的清晰频段。
description.en: A radiant inland sea formed where the Long Tide covered the old city, home to gentle mutated seabirds that migrate along radio waves. Both Chideng and passing Awakened listeners have heard an extra old-era frequency between the waves.

kind.zh: 觉醒信标 · 尚未抵达

description.zh: 北脊山后的高地微光，只在辐射云散去的晴夜出现。觉醒者说那是另一座仍在发报的气象与影像中继站，信笺里暂时只记下了它的方向。
description.en: A highland glimmer beyond the northern ridge, visible when radiation clouds part on clear nights. The Awakened say it is an active weather and image relay station; for now, the letters record only its bearing.

kind.zh: 秩序高塔 · 远方灯火

description.zh: 围绕旧能源塔与环状净水工程重建的洁净秩序城邦，经盐环商队与避难所互通修配零件和旧纪元纪录片。城邦与贸易已纳入正式设定；站内仍未掌握可实地循行的城址与路线。
description.en: A clean, ordered city rebuilt around surviving energy towers and circular waterworks. Salt Ring caravans exchange repair parts and old-era documentaries with shelters. The city and trade are established canon; the station still lacks a surveyed location and route.

label.zh: 往返信路
label.en: Letter route

label.zh: 未证实的线索
label.en: An unconfirmed lead

label.zh: 未证实的线索
label.en: An unconfirmed lead

label.zh: 未证实的线索
label.en: An unconfirmed lead

label.zh: 商队转递线索 · 路线未核
label.en: Caravan messages · route unverified

role.zh: 影像拾荒者 · 据点管理员

description.zh: 旧风镜与拼装头灯压在帽檐上，灰绿工装补着回收布料，口袋里总有一颗不配套的螺丝。撬拆工具、防辐射呼吸面罩与胶片罐挂在胸前；嘴上嫌修理麻烦，却常和盐环聚落的变种人搬运工一起从废墟里抢出旧磁盘，从不肯把还能放映的影像留在辐射雨里。 她仍把“收到”和“证实”分栏，片名写在罐身侧签上。
description.en: Old goggles and a jury-rigged headlamp on her cap; salvaged cloth patches across grey-green workwear, one mismatched screw in every pocket. Pry tools, radiation respirator, and film canisters hang from her harness. She grumbles about repairs, yet teams up with Salt Ring mutant haulers to rescue old drives from the ruins, never leaving a playable image in the fallout rain. She still records receipt separately from verification, with titles on the sides of the tins.

quotes.zh: 先别说它坏了。给我一盏灯。
quotes.en: Don’t call it broken yet. Bring me a lamp.

quotes.zh: 带回来的不只是片子，还有回去的路。
quotes.en: We bring back more than films. We bring a way home.

quotes.zh: 这一格修好了。今晚应该能早一点开场。
quotes.en: That part is fixed. We might start a little earlier tonight.

quotes.zh: 哟，回来了。今天淘着啥好货了？
quotes.en: Back again? What good finds did you bring today?

quotes.zh: 这批影像登记好了，片架给你留了位置。
quotes.en: These images are logged. There is room for them on the shelf.

quotes.zh: 字放清楚些。路还长，慢慢读。
quotes.en: Keep the writing clear. There is a long road ahead; take your time reading.

quotes.zh: 片罐的标签写在侧面。盖子磨花了，名字也不会跟着丢。
quotes.en: Put the label on the side of the film can. A worn lid should not take its name with it.

quotes.zh: 收到的信先压平。纸上的事，还要一件件核实。
quotes.en: Flatten the letter first. What it says still needs checking, one thing at a time.

quotes.zh: 登记簿的夹页别抽走。两边的来信各有去处，回头才找得到。
quotes.en: Leave the dividers in the logbook. Each bundle of letters has its place; we need to find them again.

quotes.zh: 沉没档案馆的自进化孢子倒是懂事，把文明纪元的铁盒裹得严严实实，一滴潮水都没漏进去。
quotes.en: The self-evolving spores in the Drowned Archive know their job—wrapped those Civilization Era tins so tight not a drop of tidewater got in.

quotes.zh: 不管是理想城捎来的精密零件，还是聚落变种人兄弟扛来的旧硬盘，进了放映站，都得先登记上册。
quotes.en: Whether it is a precision part from Ideal City or an old drive hauled in by our mutant friends from the settlement, everything gets logged at the counter first.

quotes.zh: 核火烧掉了旧世界的街牌，但只要片头字幕还能亮起来，那些日子就不算彻底消失。
quotes.en: Nuclear fire burned away the old world's street signs, but as long as the opening credits still light up, those days are not truly gone.

quotes.zh: 同一只片匣，纸条夹在一起。别翻一页，就重抄一遍。
quotes.en: Keep the slips for one film case together. Turning a page should not mean copying them all again.

quotes.zh: 路牌写清来处，细账夹进簿里。找片匣的人，不必先读完一页告示。
quotes.en: Put the way in plain sight and keep the fine print in the ledger. No one should need a page of notices to find a film case.

personality.zh: 嘴硬心软 · 务实利落 · 珍视旧纪元遗物 · 对聚落来客一视同仁
personality.en: Sharp-tongued yet warm · Pragmatic · Guards old-era relics · Welcomes every traveler

role.zh: 放映站守夜人 · 旧设备修理师

description.zh: 灰白的鬓角，补过三次的铜线耳机；旧工装外罩着磨损的维修围裙，表笔、电线和钳子各有落脚处。提灯用回收金属拼了护网，灯罩边常停着循光而来的温顺孢子蛾。他记得每台文明纪元放映机的脾气，也常和路过的觉醒者一起校准旧广播频段，却总忘记自己的茶已经凉了。 拆下的垫圈按尺寸串回细铁丝，桌边留着尚未送出的回条。
description.en: Grey at the temples, copper-wired headphones patched three times. A worn repair apron over old coveralls holds meter probes, wire, and pliers. Scrap metal guards his work light, where gentle spore-moths often rest. He remembers every Civilization Era projector's temperament and tunes old broadcast bands with passing Awakened listeners, yet always forgets his tea has gone cold. Removed washers return to a wire sorted by size; an unsent reply waits beside his desk.

quotes.zh: 灯亮着，就还有人知道往哪儿走。
quotes.en: While the light is on, someone still knows the way.

quotes.zh: 锁扣收好了。幕布是留给影像的。
quotes.en: The clasp is put away. The screen belongs to the picture.

quotes.zh: 别急，先听它转完这一圈。
quotes.en: No hurry. Listen until it makes one full turn.

quotes.zh: 先把设备调顺，今晚安心看。
quotes.en: Get the equipment settled, then enjoy tonight’s screening.

quotes.zh: 灯可以换，片子的底色不能认错。
quotes.en: You can change the lamp. You must still read the picture's colors correctly.

quotes.zh: 转轴修好了。你看你的，我把守夜灯留着。
quotes.en: The pivot is fixed. Keep watching; I'll leave the night lamp on.

quotes.zh: 银幕上的人动起来，我才敢把工具收回箱里。
quotes.en: I'll put the tools away when the people on the screen start moving.

quotes.zh: 幕布展开了，坐吧。
quotes.en: The screen is open. Take a seat.

quotes.zh: 线接好了。歇会儿也成，回来接着放。
quotes.en: The line is patched. Take a break; the next reel can wait for you.

quotes.zh: 旧零件别急着扔。先认清哪块该干什么活。
quotes.en: Don't throw the old parts away yet. First work out which one belongs on which job.

quotes.zh: 垫圈按尺寸串在细铁丝上。合不上，拧得再紧也不会稳。
quotes.en: Sort the washers on a thin wire by size. Tightening the wrong one will not make it fit.

quotes.zh: 昨晚有位觉醒者路过，帮我把回声海飘来的杂音滤干净了；原来那是文明纪元最后一班列车的报站声。
quotes.en: An Awakened traveler passed by last night and helped me filter the static from the Echo Sea; it turned out to be the station call of the Civilization Era's last train.

quotes.zh: 线盘别缠死。留一截松线，下次检修才不必把整架拆开。
quotes.en: Leave some slack on the cable reel. The next repair should not mean taking the whole rack apart.

quotes.zh: 先记哪盏灯先灭，再拿钳子。一次换三根线，谁也说不清是哪根坏了。
quotes.en: Note which lamp went dark first, then reach for the pliers. Change three wires at once and nobody knows which one was faulty.

quotes.zh: 片匣还在路上，空转的机器催不来它。先看送片的路，再动扳手。
quotes.en: Running the projector will not bring a film case in sooner. Check the delivery road before reaching for the wrench.

quotes.zh: 纸响不算片子到了。先看片轮走了几格，再把那一格记上。
quotes.en: Rustling paper does not mean the reel has arrived. Watch how far the reel turns, then mark only what moved.

quotes.zh: 几盘可以一起理，片号得一格格对。缺的地方先留白，不能算齐了。
quotes.en: Sort the trays together, but check the frame numbers in order. Leave a gap where a frame is missing; do not call it complete.

personality.zh: 温和沉静 · 慢条斯理 · 熟稔机械与频段 · 常为夜归人留灯
personality.en: Gentle and unhurried · Patient with machines and frequencies · Keeps a lamp for night travelers

role.zh: 盐环路标师 · 往返列站的递信人

description.zh: 短发间别着一支褪色的红铅笔，防尘短雨披和回收背架上尽是修补痕迹，绳索、片罐与净水水壶沿着橙色肩带固定。她常与幸存者聚落的变种人向导结伴穿行盐原，懂得根据变异兽群的迁徙避开辐射风带；地图贴身收着，罗盘从不离手，没走过的路线一律画成虚线。 商队的口信可以转递，但未亲走的路线仍保留虚线。
description.en: A faded red pencil tucked into short hair, repairs across her dust poncho and salvaged pack frame. Rope, film canisters, and a purified-water flask sit along an orange strap. She crosses the salt flats with mutant guides from the survivor settlements and reads mutated herd migrations to skirt fallout winds. Unwalked routes stay dotted on her map. She can carry a caravan’s message without claiming to have walked its route; unwalked ground stays dotted.

quotes.zh: 没走过的路，我会画成虚线。
quotes.en: A road I haven’t walked gets a dotted line.

quotes.zh: 地图可以旧，路标不能含糊。
quotes.en: A map may age. A signpost must stay clear.

quotes.zh: 下一封信，等我过了盐环再寄。
quotes.en: The next letter goes out once I cross the Salt Ring.

quotes.zh: 地址写清，回来的路就不会断。
quotes.en: Write the address clearly, and the way back will stay unbroken.

quotes.zh: 盐环聚落的变种人铁匠替我加固了背架，这一趟能多背四盒旧纪元纪录片。
quotes.en: The mutant blacksmith at the Salt Ring settlement reinforced my pack frame; I can carry four more old-era documentary reels this trip.

quotes.zh: 看到发光的自进化孢子往高处爬，就说明辐射潮要涨了——跟着它们的边界走，准能绕回避难所。
quotes.en: When glowing self-evolving spores climb to higher ground, the radiant tide is rising—follow their edge and you will make it back to the shelter.

personality.zh: 言简意赅 · 严谨重诺 · 只认亲脚丈量的实路 · 熟知废土生态
personality.en: Concise and steadfast · Trusts only walked ground · Reads wasteland ecology with care

text.zh: 守夜人把锁扣收进口袋，让影像占回幕布。
text.en: The night keeper pocketed the clasp, returning the screen to the picture.

text.zh: 柜台展开第一张图谱。拾荒者与守夜人留下名字，盐环的递信人也有了自己的声音。
text.en: The first atlas opens on the counter. Scavenger and night keeper leave their names; the Salt Ring runner finds a voice of her own.

text.zh: 阿汐把「映汐放映站」的新名牌钉上门楣，又把档案室的指示牌挪到门外。迟灯擦亮了耳机上的铜线，弥途终于让画师留下了那支红铅笔。
text.en: Axi fixed the new Yingxi Station sign above the door and moved the archives sign outside. Chideng polished the copper on his headphones; Mitu finally persuaded the portrait artist to keep her red pencil.

text.zh: 三人的肖像重新挂回档案室。阿汐带着拆解工具，迟灯提起拼装工作灯，弥途没有卸下背架；门后的冷光照见每一道补丁。
text.en: Three repainted portraits return to the archives: Axi with her salvage tools, Chideng with a rebuilt work light, Mitu still carrying her pack frame. The cool light beyond the door reveals every patch.

text.zh: 阿汐开始登记每天的新拾获；迟灯从幕布右侧递来一句话，弥途把外部避难所的路标擦亮。
text.en: Axi logs each day’s new finds. Chideng offers a few words from the screen’s edge, while Mitu freshens the sign to the outer shelters.

text.zh: 阿汐重新铺平柜台的信纸，档案边的一圈圆线标记着正在读的来信。
text.en: Axi laid the counter's letter flat again. A circular mark beside the records shows which letter is open.

text.zh: 档案里的字调得更清楚，长句不必再挤成一行。
text.en: Archive text grows clearer; long lines no longer need to squeeze into one row.

text.zh: 据点与片库的路标沿用同一套门牌，暖纸与深绿告示牌衔接起来。
text.en: Connections and shelves share consistent signs, with warm paper beside pine-green notices.

text.zh: 探索从片架旁独立出来，登记后的短笺在下方轻轻递到手边。
text.en: Exploration gains its own place beside the shelves, with a quiet note after registration.

text.zh: 旧词重新校对，放映与登记的边界写得更明白。
text.en: Old words are checked again, making the boundaries of screening and registration clearer.

text.zh: 阿汐把散落在旧信上的短句归回档案，又将词笺上的既有记录、传闻与待议事项分别注明。弥途没有把虚线改成实线。
text.en: Axi returned lines from old letters to the archives and marked the dictionary’s records, rumors, and proposals separately. Mitu left the dotted routes dotted.

text.zh: 封存柜只收起私密登记，影像仍留在原处；回到柜前再核验身份。
text.en: The sealed cabinet hides private registrations while images stay in place; identity is checked on returning.

text.zh: 画纸换了轻一些的封装，边缘与原色仍留着，更新柜台也归回纸页下方。
text.en: Artwork receives lighter wrapping without losing its edges or colors, and the update counter returns below the page.

text.zh: 映汐放映站换上统一的门牌。弥途带回盐环列站的未署名回信，阿汐分开记下“收到”与“证实”，迟灯写好的回条仍留在片架旁。
text.en: Yingxi Station settles on one name above the door. Mitu brings an unsigned reply from the Salt Ring Stops; Axi records receipt separately from verification, while Chideng’s answer waits beside the shelf.

text.zh: 据点与信号塔各自摆好牌架，放映途中已取回的片段得以接续使用。
text.en: Outposts and relays regain separate signs, while retrieved pieces of a screening can be reused.

text.zh: 地下站的日常与共生生态归入同一套档案；性格侧写、路标和双语札记都补齐了侧签。
text.en: Underground life and symbiotic ecology join one archive, with clear labels for resident profiles, markers and bilingual journal notes.

text.zh: 迟灯松开检修架后缠死的线盘，用旧皮带收好余线，给下一次换接头留出转身的空隙。
text.en: Chideng untangles the cable reel behind the repair rack and gathers the slack with an old belt, leaving room for the next connector repair.

text.zh: 迟灯给检修纸留出一栏，先记哪盏灯灭了、等了多久，再拿钳子查接头。
text.en: Chideng leaves a column on the repair slip for which lamp went dark and how long it waited before reaching for the pliers.

text.zh: 阿汐将同一片匣的登记纸与检修纸夹好，迟灯翻查时不用再往登记台跑一趟。
text.en: Axi clips each film case’s registration and repair slips together, saving Chideng another trip to the desk.

text.zh: 阿汐收起片架旁重复的附记，将来处写在路牌上；迟灯把细账夹进登记簿，翻查时仍能找到。
text.en: Axi takes down repeated notes beside the film rack and marks the way on its sign. Chideng keeps the details in the ledger for later reference.

text.zh: 迟灯在进片口旁留一截退役胶片，试齿轮咬合；阿汐擦净片匣上的湿砂，再把到站时刻抄进登记簿。晚到的片匣与不亮的灯，分开记在两行。
text.en: Chideng keeps a retired strip by the film gate to check the sprockets. Axi wipes wet sand from each case and records its arrival. Late cases and unlit lamps go on separate lines.

text.zh: 迟灯把几只浅铁盘并排放好，盘边夹着片号，缺格仍留白。阿汐接过检修纸，先对齐号码，再把完整片匣放回架上。
text.en: Chideng lines up the shallow trays, case numbers clipped to their rims and missing frames left blank. Axi aligns the numbers on the repair sheet before returning a complete case to the shelf.

text.zh: 迟灯裁齐桌边的旧纸签，阿汐把零碎备注翻到背面。值班札记轮到谁，就把谁的肖像摆在旁边；片架与采集频段的标记也重新理顺。
text.en: Chideng trims the old desk labels while Axi moves spare notes to the back. Each journal note now sits beside its writer’s portrait; the shelves and collection controls are tidied too.

text.zh: 弥途在片匣角上补记来处，空白路段仍不落墨。放映机重新接上快转的节拍；分册收拢到同一张登记纸，封存柜的路标移到拾荒记录旁。
text.en: Mitu adds the place of origin to a case corner, leaving unverified stretches blank. The projector follows the faster beat again; collections share one register, and the cabinet sign moves beside the scavenging records.

text.zh: 迟灯压低灯罩，阿汐依本机记录排好看过的片匣。拾荒足迹与地图上的待核路线各留一页；可用的清晰度由信源交回，原画仍留在手边。
text.en: Chideng lowers the lampshade while Axi orders the watched cases from local records. Viewing footprints and unverified map routes keep separate pages; the source supplies its available picture choices, with the original still at hand.

text.zh: 阿汐把散开的旧事收回档案架，只在纸脊记一枚片号。片匣封面留给画面，札记下的小门也收起多余的空隙；探索桌上的新玩法仍是一张待采用的草图。
text.en: Axi returns the loose records to the archive shelf, leaving one case number on each spine. Pictures keep their covers, and the small archive door below the journal sheds its spare space. New exploration games remain a sketch awaiting adoption.

text.zh: 阿汐把六盘练习片匣摆进探索页。纸签可以点选或长按拖放；离开再回来，桌面还留在刚才的样子。
text.en: Axi set six trays of practice cases in Explore. Tap labels or hold and drag them; leave and return to find the desk as you left it.

boundary.zh: 核爆长潮、地下放映站、共生生态与理想城贸易已正式采用。地图实线表示站内已核路线，虚线仍是待核位置或路径；人物台词不能代替实地记录。第二章的未署名寄信人及其设备情况仍未证实，回条尚未寄出。应用权限、连接与播放能力保持真实，不随剧情自动解锁或获得修复能力。
boundary.en: The Nuclear Long Tide, underground station, symbiotic ecology and Ideal City trade are adopted canon. Solid lines are routes verified by the station; dotted lines are unsurveyed locations or paths, and dialogue is not a field survey. Chapter II’s unsigned sender and equipment claims remain unverified, and its reply is unsent. Permissions, connections and playback capabilities stay factual, without story-based unlocks or repair powers.

summary.zh: 核爆毁灭前的旧文明时代，留下地下掩体、铁路设施、能源塔、净水工程，以及散落在磁盘、服务器和胶片盒中的影像与声轨遗物。
summary.en: The age before nuclear destruction, leaving shelters, railway works, energy towers, waterworks, and image and sound records scattered across drives, servers and film tins.

summary.zh: 核爆毁灭文明纪元，并引发地质与气候剧变，继而形成漫过旧城的长潮。核爆事件与后续长潮分别记录，不把两者当作同一个瞬间。
summary.en: Nuclear destruction ends the Civilization Era and triggers geological and climatic upheaval, followed by the Long Tide across old cities. The blast and the ensuing tide are distinct events, not one instant.

summary.zh: 核爆与长潮重塑地表后的当下纪元。辐射渐退的土地上，地下避难所、地表聚落与理想城相互往来，多元生命共同生活。辐射渐退不代表所有区域均已安全。
summary.en: The present era after nuclear fire and the Long Tide reshape the surface. Shelters, settlements and Ideal City share a world of diverse life as radiation recedes; receding radiation does not make every area safe.

summary.zh: 居民对文明纪元及其遗存的日常称呼。
summary.en: The everyday name for the Civilization Era and what survives from it.

summary.zh: 核爆所引发地质与气候剧变后的漫长潮水，淹没旧城并参与重塑废土地貌。它与核爆合称核爆长潮；潮水持续多久、覆盖多广仍留待展开。
summary.en: The prolonged waters following nuclear-driven geological and climatic upheaval, flooding old cities and reshaping the wasteland. Together with the blasts they form the Nuclear Long Tide sequence; duration and extent remain open.

proposal.zh: 长潮的具体年月、持续时间和不同地域的退潮过程仍待后续故事展开。
proposal.en: Dates, duration and regional patterns of retreat remain for future stories.

summary.zh: 由文明纪元地下掩体、旧铁路隧道和重型混凝土隔离门改建的防辐射据点；映汐放映站属于这一类。应用中的避难所入口只是连接登记，不说明真实服务器位于地下。
summary.en: Radiation shelters adapted from old bunkers, railway tunnels and heavy concrete doors. Yingxi Station belongs to this group. The app’s shelter entrance is a connection register, not a claim that servers are underground.

summary.zh: 人类、变种人工匠与觉醒者依托停运列站、盐原高地和净水井组成的共生社区。盐环列站是已知聚落；职业举例不限制个体的身份与选择。
summary.en: Communities of humans, mutant craftspeople and Awakened residents around disused stations, salt highlands and wells. Salt Ring is a known settlement; example occupations do not determine every individual’s identity.

summary.zh: 围绕旧能源塔与环状净水工程重建的洁净秩序城邦，经盐环商队与避难所互通修配零件和旧纪元纪录片。城邦与贸易已纳入正式设定；站内仍未掌握可实地循行的城址与路线。
summary.en: A clean, ordered city rebuilt around surviving energy towers and circular waterworks. Salt Ring caravans exchange repair parts and old-era documentaries with shelters. The city and trade are established canon; the station still lacks a surveyed location and route.

summary.zh: 核后辐射演化出的多样生灵，已记录的温顺种群包括循无线电波迁徙的回声海水鸟、趋光孢子蛾和盐原驮兽，与据点居民形成共处生态。
summary.en: Diverse life shaped by postwar radiation. Recorded gentle populations include radio-guided Echo Sea birds, light-seeking spore moths and saltland pack animals, sharing an ecology with station residents.

summary.zh: 潮湿废墟与沉没档案馆中的共生荧光菌群，能利用残余辐射与微弱电磁信号迭代，在密封胶片盒外结成隔绝潮水与盐雾的透气菌膜。盒内干爽不等于整片废墟已经安全。
summary.en: Symbiotic luminous colonies in damp ruins and the Drowned Archive, using residual radiation and weak electromagnetic signals to evolve. Their breathable membrane shields sealed film tins from water and salt spray; a dry tin does not make an entire ruin safe.

summary.zh: 核辐射造成体格异变的强韧幸存者后裔；聚落中可见铁匠、搬运工和盐原向导，也常帮助放映站加固片架、抢救旧磁盘。具体角色的族群仍须单独确立。
summary.en: Resilient descendants of survivors with radiation-altered physiques. Blacksmiths, porters and saltland guides help reinforce shelves and recover drives. The ancestry of each named character still needs its own establishment.

summary.zh: 感官适应核后电磁异变与旧纪元神经残留的人类分支，能感知无线电频段和磁场偏转，常协助迟灯辨认杂音、校准频段和破译受损音轨。具体能力范围、代价与恢复条件仍待个体故事展开。
summary.en: A human branch whose senses adapt to postwar electromagnetic changes and old-era neural remnants. They perceive radio bands and magnetic shifts, helping Chideng identify static, tune bands and interpret damaged sound. Range, costs and recovery conditions remain for individual stories.

proposal.zh: 觉醒能力的具体作用范围、代价与恢复条件仍待逐个个体展开；现有三位角色的觉醒状态未知。
proposal.en: Range, costs and recovery conditions require individual stories; the three existing residents’ Awakened status remains unknown.

summary.zh: 搜集、辨认和保存散落影像的人；阿汐拥有这一身份。
summary.en: Someone who gathers, identifies, and preserves scattered images; this is one of Axi’s established roles.

summary.zh: 记录通行条件并维护路标的人；弥途将未走过的路线画成虚线。
summary.en: Someone who records travel conditions and maintains signs; Mitu marks unwalked routes with dotted lines.

summary.zh: 在地点之间递送消息的人；弥途往返盐环列站。
summary.en: Someone who carries messages between places; Mitu travels to and from the Salt Ring Stops.

summary.zh: 旧铁路线终点地下避难所中的最后一间放映室，阿汐登记影像、迟灯维护设备。应用与据点统一使用映汐放映站；片罐侧签、垫圈细铁丝和第二章回信延续其日常。迟灯在检修架后留出一截松线，用旧皮带收住余线，换接头时不必扯动整排设备。 迟灯在检修纸上先画灭掉的指示灯，再标待查的接头；纸上记现象，不把猜测当结论。 阿汐把同一片匣的登记纸与检修纸夹在一起，迟灯翻查时沿用同一份记录。 迟灯用空片罐压住检修纸的一角，片轮实走一格才落一笔，停住的空栏交给阿汐留待核对。 迟灯把待理的胶片分放在几只浅铁盘里，每盘边缘夹着同一片匣的片号；缺号的空处先留白，交给阿汐继续核对。 迟灯把桌边长短不一的旧纸签裁齐，留下两行写片名，零碎备注另记在背面。 弥途把来处写在片匣角上，与两行片名的旧纸签并排，不再往纸签下面反复添抄。 夜里，迟灯把灯罩压低一格，让光留在检修纸上，过道旁的人不必迎着灯光。 阿汐把散开的据点旧事夹回档案架，在纸脊补记小片号，片匣封面则留给画面。
summary.en: The last screening room in an underground shelter at the old railway terminus. Axi registers images and Chideng tends equipment. App and story share the Yingxi Station name; tin labels, threaded washers and Chapter II’s reply extend its everyday life. Chideng leaves slack behind the repair rack and gathers the spare cable with an old belt, so a connector can be replaced without pulling the whole row of equipment. Chideng sketches the dark indicator lamp on a repair slip before marking the connector to inspect; the slip records observations rather than treating guesses as conclusions. Axi clips the registration and repair slips for each film case together, so Chideng can consult the same record. Chideng weighs down a corner of the repair sheet with an empty film can, marking only each step the reel actually turns; Axi leaves the stopped intervals blank for checking. Chideng sorts film into shallow iron trays, each carrying the same case number. Gaps in the frame sequence stay blank for Axi to check. Chideng trims the desk labels to a common size, leaving two lines for titles and keeping spare notes on the back. Mitu writes the place of origin on a case corner beside the two-line title label, rather than copying it below the label again. At night Chideng lowers the lampshade one notch, keeping light on the repair sheet and out of passing eyes. Axi returns loose station records to the archive shelf and numbers the paper spines, leaving the case covers to their pictures.

proposal.zh: 可逐步发展为聚落间的公共影像档案节点；具体建筑结构与自治制度尚未确定。
proposal.en: It may grow into a shared image archive between communities; its architecture and local governance remain unspecified.

summary.zh: 盐壳包住停运车厢的已知地点，弥途在这里维护通行路标。
summary.en: An established place of salt-crusted railway carriages where Mitu maintains route markers.

proposal.zh: 可发展为铁路聚落与递信中转地；多座避难所、商队和理想城通路尚未确认为已通行路线。
proposal.en: It may develop as a railway community and letter relay; routes to multiple shelters, caravans, or Ideal City are not established.

summary.zh: 第一章地点与联系的记录。实线标确认信路，虚线保留传闻。
summary.en: A record of Chapter I places and connections. Solid lines mark an established letter route; dotted lines preserve rumors.

summary.zh: 档案室内按应用版本选录的据点变化，不是完整版本史或废土年表。
summary.en: Selected station changes kept in the archives by app version, not a complete release history or wasteland chronology.

summary.zh: 记录每版实际改动的更新说明，人物动作或语录放在末尾。
summary.en: Release notes describing actual changes, with a character moment or quote at the end.

summary.zh: 核爆后沉入回声海的文明纪元资料库，退潮时露出圆形屋顶。馆内冷光闪烁的自进化孢子包裹着密封胶片盒，替旧世界守住了未受潮水侵蚀的底片。 这些背景已被作者采用为正式设定，但站内实地路标与到达路线仍属传闻。
summary.en: A Civilization Era repository submerged after the nuclear fall, its circular roof exposed at low tide. Bioluminescent self-evolving spores wrap the sealed film cans inside, shielding old reels from the water. These background facts are adopted canon, while the station’s location evidence and access route remain hearsay.

summary.zh: 核爆与长潮漫过旧城形成的辐射内海，岸边栖息着循电磁波迁徙的温和变异水鸟。迟灯与路过的觉醒者都听见过，海浪里偶尔会多出一个旧纪元的清晰频段。 这些背景已被作者采用为正式设定，但站内实地路标与到达路线仍属传闻。
summary.en: A radiant inland sea formed where the Long Tide covered the old city, home to gentle mutated seabirds that migrate along radio waves. Both Chideng and passing Awakened listeners have heard an extra old-era frequency between the waves. These background facts are adopted canon, while the station’s location evidence and access route remain hearsay.

summary.zh: 北脊山后的高地微光，只在辐射云散去的晴夜出现。觉醒者说那是另一座仍在发报的气象与影像中继站，信笺里暂时只记下了它的方向。 这些背景已被作者采用为正式设定，但站内实地路标与到达路线仍属传闻。
summary.en: A highland glimmer beyond the northern ridge, visible when radiation clouds part on clear nights. The Awakened say it is an active weather and image relay station; for now, the letters record only its bearing. These background facts are adopted canon, while the station’s location evidence and access route remain hearsay.

summary.zh: 第二章中，弥途从盐环列站带回的未署名纸条，由阿汐登记并保存在映汐放映站。确认的是纸条被带回；寄信人身份、纸上描述的旧设备情况尚未证实。迟灯写好的回条尚未送出，不据此新增信路。
summary.en: The unsigned note Mitu brings from the Salt Ring Stops in Chapter II, registered by Axi at Yingxi Station. Its arrival is established; the sender and equipment claims are unverified. Chideng’s answer has not been sent, so it establishes no new route.

summary.zh: 核爆及其引发的地质、气候与漫长潮水的灾变序列合称，终结文明纪元并重塑废土地表；不是把核爆和潮水压成同一瞬间。
summary.en: The collective disaster sequence of nuclear blasts and the geological, climatic and prolonged tidal changes they trigger, ending the Civilization Era and reshaping the surface; not a single simultaneous event.

summary.zh: 循无线电波迁徙的温顺变异水鸟。循波导航与孢子蛾的趋光习性不同；出现一只水鸟不自动证明其出发地和可通行路线。
summary.en: Gentle mutated birds migrating along radio signals. Their radio guidance differs from spore moths’ attraction to light; one sighting does not establish origin or a passable route.

summary.zh: 常在灯罩边停留的趋光温顺生灵，迟灯的值夜日常中可见。名称不意味着它们就是自进化孢子，具体共生方式仍可展开。
summary.en: Gentle light-seeking creatures seen beside Chideng’s lamp. Their name does not make them the same organism as the spores; the exact symbiosis can unfold later.

summary.zh: 适应盐原环境的温顺变异驮兽，可伴聚落向导与商队负重出行。具体驯养制度、数量与路线没有因此定案。
summary.en: Gentle mutated pack animals adapted to the saltlands, accompanying guides and caravans. Their number, husbandry and precise routes remain unspecified.

title.en: Chapter I · The light is still on

introduction.zh: 灯还亮着。先认得守灯的人，再沿已有的路标向外看。
introduction.en: The light is still on. Meet the people who tend it, then follow the markers already on the map.

body.zh:
这里是映汐放映站。阿汐收拾片架，迟灯照看旧设备，弥途把盐环列站的路标一笔笔记清。

地图上的实线，留给已经走过的路。虚线后面的名字先夹在信里，等有了凭据再描实。

灯还亮着。带回来的影像，慢慢看。
body.en:
This is Yingxi Station. Axi keeps the shelves, Chideng tends the old equipment, and Mitu records the markers to the Salt Ring Stops.

Solid lines belong to paths already travelled. Names beyond the dotted lines stay between the pages until there is evidence to ink them in.

The lamp is still on. There is time to watch what you brought back.

introduction.zh: 弥途沿已知信路带回一片未署名的回信。纸张到了放映站，写信的人仍留在纸外。
introduction.en: Mitu brings an unsigned reply along the known mail route. The paper has reached the station; its writer remains outside the record.

title.en: A folded page in a film tin

body.zh:
盐环列站的一只空片罐里，多了一张折成四折的纸。弥途没有抹掉边角的盐粉，把纸和片罐一并带回放映站。

纸上写着：“上回留下的影像，我们看到了。灯到了夜里会晃，声音也只剩半段。你们还放映吗？下回请把片名写在罐身上。”

没有署名，也没有新的地址。弥途在记录后面添了一行：纸条来自盐环列站；写信的人，还不知道。
body.en:
A page folded into quarters was waiting inside an empty film tin at the Salt Ring Stops. Mitu left the salt dust on its corners and carried both back to the station.

It read: “We saw the images left last time. At night the lamp flickers, and only half the sound remains. Are you still screening? Next time, please write the title on the tin.”

There was no signature and no new address. Mitu added one line: found at the Salt Ring Stops; writer unknown.

title.en: A place for an unsigned reply

body.zh:
阿汐把折纸铺在干布上，用一只空片罐压住卷起的边角。侧签先写“回信残页”，寄信人一栏留白。

她没有把纸上的每句话抄进已确认记录。纸条已经收到，灯和声音的情况却还没人核实。

“收到”和“证实”，阿汐在登记页上隔开了两行。迟灯伸手拿纸时，她指了指片罐侧面：新写的片名也要留在这里，盖子丢了，名字还在。
body.en:
Axi spread the page on a dry cloth and held its curled corner beneath an empty tin. She labelled it “reply fragment” and left the sender blank.

She did not copy every claim into the confirmed record. The note had arrived, but no one had checked the lamp or the sound.

“Received” and “verified” went on separate lines. When Chideng reached for the paper, Axi tapped the side of the tin: put the title here too; a missing lid should not take the name with it.

body.zh:
迟灯把检修用的垫圈串回细铁丝，腾出桌面。他对着纸条看了一会儿，没有写下远处设备的故障结论。

他另找一张纸，写道：“这里还放映。片名会写在罐身上。若你经过盐环列站，请把设备的样子和缺失声音的片段记下来。”

阿汐把这张回条夹在原纸后面。弥途认得的路线仍只有原来的实线；回条留在片架旁，等下一次真正出发时再带上。
body.en:
Chideng threaded the repair washers back onto their thin wire and cleared the desk. He studied the note without diagnosing equipment he had not seen.

On a fresh sheet he wrote: “We are still screening. The title will go on the tin. If you pass the Salt Ring Stops, record what the equipment looks like and which part of the sound is missing.”

Axi filed the reply behind the original. Mitu’s known route remained the same solid line. The new page stayed beside the shelf, waiting for an actual departure.

meaning.zh: 应用品牌与故事据点共用名称；应用功能不等于故事实体。
meaning.en: The app and story station share a name; app functions are separate from fictional entities.

meaning.zh: 按SMB/SFTP和网盘/WebDAV连接类别显示；不是新增地图地点。
meaning.en: Names follow SMB/SFTP and cloud/WebDAV connection categories; they add no map locations.

meaning.zh: 只移除本机连接和目录路标，不删除原文件。
meaning.en: Remove a local connection and its directory markers, leaving original files intact.

meaning.zh: 打开已登记的远程信源，包含幸存者据点和信号塔。
meaning.en: Open registered remote sources, including survivor outposts and signal towers.

meaning.zh: 核对连接账户密码；不替代系统身份认证或服务器指纹核验。
meaning.en: Check connection credentials; separate from system authentication and host-key verification.

meaning.zh: 轮换人物文字语录，不播放朗读。
meaning.en: Cycle written character quotes without speech playback.

meaning.zh: 借用拾荒称谓记录本机真实观看与续播进度；不是今日拾获、文件发现或世界纪年。
meaning.en: A scavenging metaphor for actual viewing history and resume progress, distinct from today’s finds, file discovery and story chronology.

meaning.zh: 从实际保存的位置续播。
meaning.en: Resume from the saved playback position.

meaning.zh: 应用全局设置；播放器内部保留播放设置。
meaning.en: Global app settings; player controls retain playback settings.

meaning.zh: 查看真实版本与更新信笺，下载和安装操作保留原名。
meaning.en: Actual versions and release letters; download and install actions retain explicit labels.

meaning.zh: 应用筛选和菜单中指已收藏的连接或目录入口；标记和取消标记不移动、不下载影片。故事里的物理路标保持原义。
meaning.en: Saved connection or directory entries in app filters and menus. Marking or unmarking neither moves nor downloads films; physical markers retain their story meaning.

meaning.zh: 菜单中的远程媒体来源入口，登记并浏览幸存者据点（SMB／SFTP）和信号塔（WebDAV／网盘）。
meaning.en: Manage sections and connection or directory markers. Section fields remain explicit; the name adds no signal technology or fictional institution.

meaning.zh: 按实际网络范围探测服务；发现候选与认证可用分开。
meaning.en: Probe within the actual network scope; discovery is separate from authenticated access.

meaning.zh: 连接表单分节；地址、协议和主机IP保持准确。
meaning.en: Connection-form headings; addresses, protocols and host IP remain explicit.

meaning.zh: 连接账户表单分节；用户名与密码字段不隐喻化。
meaning.en: The connection account section; username and password remain literal.

meaning.zh: 连接端口、根目录等选项；不是新的物理信路。
meaning.en: Connection options such as port and root directory, separate from physical mail routes.

meaning.zh: 探索中的离线纸签配对练习；只整理虚构片匣，不修改影片、不发放物资、不推进章节。
meaning.en: An offline paper-label matching practice in Explore. It uses fictional cases, changes no films, grants no supplies and advances no chapters.

note.zh: 地下放映站、核爆引发长潮、共生生态与理想城贸易已正式采用。作者设定与据点调查分开：虚线表示位置或路线尚未实测，不表示城邦和物种未被写入正史。
note.en: The underground station, nuclear origins of the Long Tide, symbiotic ecology and Ideal City trade are adopted canon. Authorial facts and station surveys are separate: dotted lines mark unsurveyed locations or routes, not the absence of cities or species from canon.

text.zh: 片罐侧签补好了，盖子丢了，片名也不会跟着走。
text.en: The side labels are mended. A missing lid will not take the title with it.

text.zh: 迟灯把垫圈串回细铁丝，给下一次检修留出桌面。
text.en: Chideng threaded the washers back onto their wire, clearing the desk for the next repair.

text.zh: 弥途重描了盐环的旧路标，虚线处仍留着空白。
text.en: Mitu retraced the Salt Ring markers and left the dotted ground blank.

text.zh: 新收到的纸条压在干布下，寄信人的名字先空着。
text.en: The newly received note lies beneath a dry cloth; the sender stays unnamed.

text.zh: 片架旁留着一张回条，等真正出发时再带上。
text.en: A reply waits beside the shelf until someone truly departs.

text.zh: 灯亮着。带回来的影像，今天也能慢慢看。
text.en: The lamp is on. There is time today to watch what came back.

text.zh: 今天也有值得留下的影像。
text.en: Today too holds images worth keeping.

text.zh: 灯亮着，旧故事就还有下一场。
text.en: While the lamp stays on, old stories still have another screening.

text.zh: 路标擦干净了，带一部好片回来。
text.en: The signposts are wiped clean; bring a good film back.

text.zh: 片架留着空位，等今天的新收获。
text.en: There is open space on the shelf for today's finds.

text.zh: 盐环聚落的商队歇过脚，留下了几盘文明纪元的老纪录片。
text.en: A caravan from the Salt Ring settlement rested here and left a few Civilization Era documentaries.

text.zh: 隔离门外的自进化孢子亮着微光，地下放映室今晚很干爽。
text.en: Self-evolving spores glow softly outside the blast door; the underground screening room is dry tonight.

text.zh: 迟灯和路过的觉醒者调准了频段，回声海的杂音少了一半。
text.en: Chideng tuned the band with a passing Awakened listener, cutting the Echo Sea static in half.

text.zh: 变种人铁匠帮忙加固了片架，再沉的旧纪元磁盘柜也放得稳。
text.en: A mutant blacksmith reinforced the shelves; even the heaviest old-era drive racks sit steady now.

text.zh: 理想城托人捎来备用灯泡，换走了两盒修好的黑白短片。
text.en: Ideal City sent spare projection bulbs in exchange for two restored black-and-white shorts.

text.zh: 辐射雨停了，循波的水鸟落在通风塔边，今晚适合看场长片。
text.en: The fallout rain has cleared and radio-guided seabirds rest by the vent tower—a good night for a feature film.

text.zh: 弥途重描北脊山下的旧虚线，没走过的路仍留白。
text.en: Mitu retraced the old dotted marks below the northern ridge; unwalked ground stays blank.

text.zh: 核火与长潮带走了旧街景，好在银幕一亮，重逢就还在原处。
text.en: Nuclear fire and the Long Tide took the old streets, yet once the screen lights up, every reunion remains in place.

text.zh: 我把桌边的旧纸签裁齐了。片名长一点没关系，别把旁边那一匣挤下去。
text.en: I trimmed the old labels along the desk. A long title is fine; just leave room for the case beside it.

text.zh: 我把来处写在片匣角上。写下一个地名，不等于那条路已经走通；地图上的空白，仍得留着。
text.en: I wrote the place of origin on the case’s corner. Naming a place does not mean the road is clear; the blank on the map must stay.

text.zh: 夜里我把灯罩压低一格，检修纸看得清，旁人的眼睛也能歇一会儿。走到哪一格，就记哪一格。
text.en: At night I lower the lampshade one notch. The repair sheet stays legible and passing eyes can rest. I mark only the steps actually taken.

text.zh: 我把散开的旧事夹回档案架，只在纸脊上添一个小小的片号。封面留给画面，想找来处的人，翻开里面那一页就好。
text.en: I return the loose station records to the archive shelf and add a small case number to each paper spine. The cover belongs to the picture; anyone looking for its origin can turn to the page inside.

text.zh: 我在练习片匣的角上画了三个小点。纸签贴对一张，就盖住一个。没有奖品，只有桌面一点点腾出来的地方。
text.en: I drew three small dots on a practice case. Each label in its place covers one. No prizes, just a little more room on the desk.

eyebrow.zh: 废墟档案库 · 旧纪元磁盘

title.zh: 核火与长潮之后，留在手边的旧片匣。
title.en: After fire and tide, an old film case stays close.

body.zh: 授权本机文件夹后，在这里浏览和归整影像；浏览不会移动或重命名原文件。
body.en: Grant access to a local folder to browse and organize its images here. Browsing neither moves nor renames the original files.

body.zh: 放映机记得每一盘旧纪元片子停在哪一格，下次推门接着看。
body.en: The projector remembers where each old-era film paused. Come back and continue from that frame.

note.zh: 三张台面总算各有各的活。我的片号可别再塞进灯罩里。
note.en: Three desks, three jobs. Keep my case numbers out of the lampshade.

clue.zh: 留给整理影像和纸签的人。
clue.en: For the keeper of images and paper labels.

label.zh: 这张纸记着片号，旁边画了半只片匣。
label.en: A case number sits beside a half-drawn film case.

hint.zh: 片号与纸签都归阿汐整理。
hint.en: Axi keeps case numbers and paper labels.

clue.en: For the keeper of old equipment.

label.zh: 灯泡接触不良，等修好再点亮。
label.en: A loose bulb contact needs repair before lighting.

hint.en: Who looks after lamps and old equipment?

clue.zh: 留给往返列站送信的人。
clue.en: For the letter runner between stations.

label.zh: 信封已经封口，只差交到递信人手上。
label.en: The envelope is sealed and ready for the runner.

hint.zh: 封好的信交给递信人弥途。
hint.en: Sealed letters go to Mitu, the letter runner.

note.zh: 封面能看见了，片号也找得着。长话留在里面慢慢说。
note.en: The cover can breathe and the number is easy to find. Longer stories can wait inside.

clue.zh: 让人一眼认出画面的那一面。
clue.en: The side that shows an image at a glance.

label.zh: 一张完整的手绘画面，四周留着空白。
label.en: A complete hand-drawn image with room around its edges.

hint.zh: 完整画面放在封面，留出呼吸的地方。
hint.en: The full image belongs on the front cover.

clue.zh: 片匣挨着站好时，还能读到的窄边。
clue.en: The narrow edge visible when cases stand together.

label.zh: 窄窄一条纸，只写着片号。
label.en: A narrow strip bearing only a case number.

hint.zh: 窄纸签贴在书脊，方便找片。
hint.en: A narrow number label fits the spine.

clue.zh: 翻开之后再慢慢读的地方。
clue.en: The place to read after opening the case.

label.zh: 一段很长的来处记录，末尾还有两行补记。
label.en: A long provenance note with two extra lines at the end.

hint.zh: 长记录放进内页，不盖住封面。
hint.en: Long notes belong inside, clear of the cover.

note.zh: 这一盘只分纸签，不替任何真实影片盖章。桌面倒是清楚多了。
note.en: These are practice labels, not stamps on real films. The desk is clearer, though.

clue.zh: 完整但还没有找到位置。
clue.en: Whole, but still without a place.

label.zh: 纸面完整，字也清楚；桌上还没给它留位置。
label.en: The paper is whole and legible, but has no place on the desk.

hint.zh: 完整又未归位，放进待整理。

clue.zh: 纸面能用，字迹需要重新誊写。
clue.en: Usable paper whose lettering needs copying.

label.zh: 纸张平整，片号却被擦得只剩半个。
label.en: The paper lies flat, but half its number has rubbed away.

hint.zh: 缺的是字，先放进待补字。
hint.en: The missing part is the lettering.

clue.en: Number and position have been checked.

label.zh: 片号对得上，位置也登记了，边角还留着确认的小点。
label.en: Number and position match the register; a small check-dot marks the corner.

hint.zh: 核对完号码与位置，才算已归档。
hint.en: Both number and position have already been checked.

note.zh: 小工具都有落脚处，明早就少一场翻箱倒柜。
note.en: Every small tool has a place. Tomorrow starts with less rummaging.

clue.en: For the small things used in lighting.

label.zh: 一只擦干净的备用灯泡。
label.en: A spare bulb, wiped clean.

hint.zh: 灯泡留在灯架旁，取用方便。
hint.en: Keep the spare bulb beside the lamp stand.

clue.zh: 放置处理旧设备的工具。
clue.en: For tools used on old equipment.

label.zh: 一把用来拧紧螺丝的小螺丝刀。
label.en: A small screwdriver for tightening loose screws.

hint.zh: 拧螺丝的工具归修理格。
hint.en: A screwdriver belongs with repair tools.

clue.zh: 放置书写与标记的小物件。

label.zh: 一支削好的铅笔，旁边夹着空白纸签。
label.en: A sharpened pencil clipped to blank labels.

hint.zh: 铅笔与空白纸签放在一起。
hint.en: Keep the pencil with the blank labels.

note.zh: 纸签也得喘口气。湿的先晾，卷的慢理，缺的重新写。
note.en: Labels need a little care: dry the damp, flatten the curled, rewrite the torn.

clue.zh: 湿纸先别急着压进匣里。
clue.en: Damp paper needs time before it enters a case.

label.zh: 纸边还带着水痕，摸上去微微发软。
label.en: Water marks linger at the edge; the paper still feels soft.

hint.en: Still damp and soft: dry it first.

clue.zh: 干燥的卷边可以慢慢理平。
clue.en: Dry curled edges can be flattened gently.

label.zh: 纸已经干了，只是角上向外翘。
label.en: The paper is dry, but one corner curls outward.

hint.zh: 干纸卷边，适合轻轻压平。
hint.en: A dry curled corner can be pressed flat.

clue.zh: 缺失的纸面需要一张新签。
clue.en: Missing paper calls for a new label.

label.zh: 纸签缺了一大角，片号无处写全。
label.en: A large corner is missing; the full number no longer fits.

hint.zh: 纸面缺失，另写一张新签。
hint.en: Missing paper needs a fresh label.

note.zh: 六盘都理过了。别赶时间，片架会等你，灯也还亮着。
note.en: Six trays sorted. No need to hurry: the shelf can wait, and the lamp is still on.

clue.zh: 先确认手里拿的是什么。
clue.en: First check what is in your hands.

label.zh: 翻开练习片匣，先读书脊上的片号。
label.en: Open the practice case and read the number on its spine.

hint.en: Read the number as you open the case.

clue.zh: 一边查看，一边核对纸面记录。
clue.en: Check the paper record while working.

label.zh: 把内页记录与纸签逐项对照。
label.en: Compare the inside note with each paper label.

hint.zh: 逐项核对是整理时的工作。
hint.en: Comparing the records is the sorting step.

clue.zh: 事情做完，再把桌面留整齐。
clue.en: Finish the work, then leave the desk tidy.

label.zh: 合上练习片匣，把铅笔放回纸签格。
label.en: Close the practice case and return the pencil to the label compartment.

hint.zh: 合匣、归还铅笔，都是收桌前的最后一步。
hint.en: Closing the case and returning the pencil finish the task.
